name: @cas/faber
description: Exterior Faber transform engine, extracted from the Quadrature Domains app (ADR-0007 second-consumer rule: QD + the Faber-transform visualizer). Given an exterior conformal map φ: 𝔻* → Ω by its Laurent expansion at ∞, builds the Faber polynomials F_n of the bounded complement K = ℂ∖Ω (three-term recurrence), the forward transform Φφ(f) = Σ b_n F_n, Durand–Kerner + Newton root-finding (over @cas/core), a readable ζ-formatter, and a per-order convergence report. Convention-neutral (ADR-0006); stands only on @cas/core. Dist-built (Flavor-B) because QD consumes it in raw Node.
author: Andrew Graven <andrew@graven.com>
